id.description: ID of the virtual extension range.

name.description: Name of the virtual extension range. This is a unique name for the virtual extension range.

prefix.description: Prefix used for a virtual extension range. Prefix works in Standard and Enhanced modes. In Standard mode, it must be E.164 and it must be unique. In Enhanced mode, it can be E.164 or non-E.164.

patterns.description: List of virtual extension patterns. The maximum number of patterns supported at a time is 100. Extension patterns can include one or more right-justified wildcards “X” matching any digit.

locationName.description: Name of the location to which the virtual extension range is assigned. This is set only for virtual extension ranges at the location level.
